preregistration.title: Eight-repository maintenance expansion
preregistration.description: Cross-language comparison of agents inspecting and modifying eight two-file repositories under public and hidden tests.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-repository success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check repository success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict repository-maintenance parity.

source_protocol.visible_files: Only the sixteen language-specific editable seed files across the eight repositories.
source_protocol.protected_files: Checker, source printer, configuration, prompt, and attempt log are never agent-readable and remain integrity-hashed.

interpretation_boundary: The primary result is the within-iteration Parley/Python/Rust comparison under gpt-5.6-sol.

The first four repository objects are exactly preserved from iteration 025; the final four repository IDs, helper boundaries, requirement statements, seed sources, and public/hidden cases are unrelated additions frozen before any iteration-026 session.
The protected source-printer output becomes measured agent context through the model session; source is not duplicated inline in the prompt.
Changed-file count and rough-token edit size are secondary maintenance metrics, not substitutes for hidden correctness or the four-condition gate.
Cross-iteration movement from size four to size eight is descriptive evidence consistent with workload amortization, not causal proof.
secondary_analysis: Report every session, repository outcome, repair, token count, elapsed time, prompt size, source size, edit size, changed-file count, integrity result, and command-protocol result.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure by unrelated repository and independent session.
Audit whether agents changed both entrypoint and helper where the requirement crosses that boundary, without making it a correctness prerequisite beyond tests.
Report exact filtered-report and priority-digest file judgments and repair-free sensitivity if at least two Parley sessions pass all eight repositories on the first check.
preregistration.feature_boundary: Parley remains frozen at v0.3.155 with the exact 1,519-character skill. The source protocol and language-neutral harness remain unchanged from iteration 025; only the preregistered corpus expands from four to eight two-file repositories.
preregistration.change_rule: No syntax, compiler, grammar, AST, checker, runtime, diagnostic, prompt skill, or benchmark instruction may change from iteration 025 output unless a signature recurs across unrelated new repositories and independent sessions, then passes general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability review.
preregistration.instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
preregistration.stop_rule: Preserve the complete result without selective reruns. If strict parity passes, preregister a larger confirmation before claiming parity. If it fails, make no same-corpus syntax or instruction change; only independently recurring general defects may enter separate design review.

source_texts.delivery_quote_repo:
include "pricing.par"

to main:
    let distance_input be ask for a number ""
    let base_input be ask for a number ""
    let per_km_input be ask for a number ""
    let distance be value of distance_input
    let base be value of base_input
    let per_km be value of per_km_input
    let service be ask ""
    let amount be (delivery_quote with distance, base, per_km, service)
    say "quote=" + amount + "|service=" + service

to delivery_quote with distance as number, base as number, per_km as number, service as text giving number:
    let quote be base + (distance * per_km)
    if service is "express":
        set quote to quote + 300
    if distance is more than 100:
        set quote to quote + 500
    give back quote
source_texts.priority_digest_repo:
to include_priority with priority as number, minimum as number giving yesno:
    give back priority is at least minimum

to format_message with index as number, priority as number, message as text giving text:
    give back index + "|" + priority + "|" + message

include "digest_rules.par"

to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let minimum_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let minimum be value of minimum_input
    let output_lines be an empty list of text
    let saved be 0
    let characters be 0
    for each index from 1 to count:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let priority be item 1 of parts as number
        let message be item 2 of parts
        if (include_priority with priority, minimum):
            add (format_message with index, priority, message) to output_lines
            set saved to saved + 1
            set characters to characters + (length of message)
    write title + "\n" to file "priority_digest.txt"
    for each index from 1 to length of output_lines:
        append (item index of output_lines) + "\n" to file "priority_digest.txt"
    let skipped be count - saved
    say "saved=" + saved + "|skipped=" + skipped + "|characters=" + characters

include "inventory.par"

to main:
    let stock_input be ask for a number ""
    let demand_input be ask for a number ""
    let reserved_input be ask for a number ""
    let stock be value of stock_input
    let demand be value of demand_input
    let reserved be value of reserved_input
    let mode be ask ""

    let backorder be demand - fulfilled

source_texts.incident_routing_repo:
include "routing.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email_count be 0
    let chat_count be 0
    let pager_count be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let severity be item 2 of parts
        let after_hours be item 3 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with severity, after_hours)
        if channel is "email":
            set email_count to email_count + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat_count to chat_count + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager_count to pager_count + 1
        say team + ":" + channel
    say "email=" + email_count + ",chat=" + chat_count + ",pager=" + pager_count

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:
    if severity is "low":
        give back "email"
    if severity is "high":
        if after_hours is "yes":
            give back "pager"
        give back "chat"
    give back "pager"
source_texts.ledger_reconciliation_repo:
to absolute_difference with expected as number, actual as number giving number:
    if expected is at least actual:
        give back expected - actual
    give back actual - expected

to is_within_tolerance with difference as number, tolerance as number giving yesno:
    give back difference is at most tolerance

include "ledger.par"

to main:
    let tolerance_input be ask for a number ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let tolerance be value of tolerance_input
    let count be value of count_input
    let matched be 0
    let unmatched be 0
    let variance be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let id be item 1 of parts
        let expected be item 2 of parts as number
        let actual be item 3 of parts as number
        let difference be (absolute_difference with expected, actual)
        set variance to variance + difference
        if (is_within_tolerance with difference, tolerance):
            set matched to matched + 1
            say id + ":match"
        otherwise:
            set unmatched to unmatched + 1
            say id + ":diff=" + difference
    say "matched=" + matched + ",unmatched=" + unmatched + ",variance=" + variance

to include_entry with entry as text, minimum as number giving yesno:
    give back length of entry is at least minimum

to format_entry with index as number, entry as text giving text:
    give back index + "|" + entry
source_texts.feature_rollout_repo:
include "rollout.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let plan be item 2 of parts
        let country be item 3 of parts
        if (is_eligible with plan, country):
            set allowed to allowed + 1
            say user + ":allow"
        otherwise:
            set denied to denied + 1
            say user + ":deny"
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied

to is_eligible with plan as text, country as text giving yesno:
    if plan is "enterprise":
        give back yes
    if plan is "pro":
        give back country is not "blocked"
    give back no

filtered_report_repo.source_text:
include "report_rules.par"

to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let minimum_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let minimum be value of minimum_input
    let output_lines be an empty list of text
    let saved be 0
    let characters be 0
    for each index from 1 to count:
        let entry be ask ""
        if (include_entry with entry, minimum):
            add (format_entry with index, entry) to output_lines
            set saved to saved + 1
            set characters to characters + (length of entry)

    for each index from 1 to length of output_lines:
        append (item index of output_lines) + "\n" to file "filtered_report.txt"
    let skipped be count - saved

incident_routing_repo.main.par:
include "routing.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email_count be 0
    let chat_count be 0
    let pager_count be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let severity be item 2 of parts
        let after_hours be item 3 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with severity, after_hours)
        if channel is "email":
            set email_count to email_count + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat_count to chat_count + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager_count to pager_count + 1
        say team + ":" + channel
    say "email=" + email_count + ",chat=" + chat_count + ",pager=" + pager_count

    let available be stock - reserved
    if available is less than 0:
        give back 0
    give back available
inventory_reservation_repo.main.par:
include "inventory.par"

to main:
    let stock_input be ask for a number ""
    let demand_input be ask for a number ""
    let reserved_input be ask for a number ""
    let stock be value of stock_input
    let demand be value of demand_input
    let reserved be value of reserved_input
    let mode be ask ""
    let available be (available_stock with stock, reserved, mode)
    let fulfilled be demand
    if fulfilled is more than available:
        set fulfilled to available
    let backorder be demand - fulfilled
    let remaining be available - fulfilled
    say "fulfilled=" + fulfilled + "|backorder=" + backorder + "|remaining=" + remaining

source_texts.filtered_report_repo:
include "report_rules.par"

to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let min_length_input be ask for a number ""
    let min_length be value of min_length_input
    let saved be 0
    let skipped be 0
    let characters be 0
    write title + "\n" to file "filtered_report.txt"
    for each index from 1 to count:
        let entry be ask ""
        if (should_include with entry, min_length):
            append (format_entry with index, entry) + "\n" to file "filtered_report.txt"
            set saved to saved + 1
            set characters to characters + (length of entry)
        otherwise:
            set skipped to skipped + 1
    say "saved=" + saved + "|skipped=" + skipped + "|characters=" + characters

to format_entry with index as number, entry as text giving text:
    give back index + "|" + entry

to should_include with entry as text, min_length as number giving yesno:
    give back (length of entry) is at least min_length
source_texts.incident_routing_repo:
include "routing.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email_count be 0
    let chat_count be 0
    let pager_count be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let severity be item 2 of parts
        let after_hours be item 3 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with severity, after_hours)
        say team + ":" + channel
        if channel is "email":
            set email_count to email_count + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat_count to chat_count + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager_count to pager_count + 1
    say "email=" + email_count + ",chat=" + chat_count + ",pager=" + pager_count

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:
    if severity is "low":
        give back "email"
    if severity is "high":
        if after_hours is "yes":
            give back "pager"
        give back "chat"
    give back "pager"
source_texts.feature_rollout_repo:
include "rollout.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let plan be item 2 of parts
        let country be item 3 of parts
        if (is_eligible with plan, country):
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied

to is_eligible with plan as text, country as text giving yesno:
    if plan is "enterprise":
        give back yes
    if plan is "pro":
        give back country is not "blocked"
    give back no

    if mode is "urgent":
        give back stock
    if reserved is more than stock:
        give back 0
    give back stock - reserved

include "inventory.par"

to main:
    let stock_input be ask for a number ""
    let demand_input be ask for a number ""
    let reserved_input be ask for a number ""
    let mode be ask ""
    let stock be value of stock_input
    let demand be value of demand_input
    let reserved be value of reserved_input
    let available be (available_stock with stock, reserved, mode)
    let fulfilled be demand
    if fulfilled is more than available:

    let backorder be demand - fulfilled
    let remaining be available - fulfilled
    say "fulfilled=" + fulfilled + "|backorder=" + backorder + "|remaining=" + remaining
source_texts.ledger_reconciliation_repo:
to absolute_difference with expected as number, actual as number giving number:
    if expected is at least actual:
        give back expected - actual
    give back actual - expected

to is_within_tolerance with difference as number, tolerance as number giving yesno:
    give back difference is at most tolerance

include "ledger.par"

to main:
    let tolerance_input be ask for a number ""
    let tolerance be value of tolerance_input
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let matched be 0
    let unmatched be 0
    let variance be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let id be item 1 of parts
        let expected be item 2 of parts as number
        let actual be item 3 of parts as number
        let difference be (absolute_difference with expected, actual)
        set variance to variance + difference
        if (is_within_tolerance with difference, tolerance):
            say id + ":match"
            set matched to matched + 1
        otherwise:
            say id + ":diff=" + difference
            set unmatched to unmatched + 1
    say "matched=" + matched + ",unmatched=" + unmatched + ",variance=" + variance

    say "matched=" + matched + ",unmatched=" + unmatched + ",variance=" + variance

from pathlib import Path
from report_rules import format_entry, should_include

title = input()
count = int(input())
min_length = int(input())
entries = [input() for _ in range(count)]
included = [
    (index, entry)
    for index, entry in enumerate(entries, 1)
    if should_include(entry, min_length)
]
contents = title + "\n" + "".join(
    format_entry(index, entry) + "\n"
    for index, entry in included
)
Path("filtered_report.txt").write_text(contents, encoding="utf-8")
saved = len(included)
characters = sum(len(entry) for _, entry in included)
print(f"saved={saved}|skipped={count - saved}|characters={characters}")

def should_include(entry: str, min_length: int) -> bool:
    return len(entry) >= min_length

    return f"{index}|{entry}"

def delivery_quote(distance: int, base: int, per_km: int, service: str) -> int:
    quote = base + distance * per_km
    if service == "express":
        quote += 300
    if distance > 100:
        quote += 500
    return quote

source_texts.feature_rollout_repo:
include "rollout.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let plan be item 2 of parts
        let country be item 3 of parts
        if (is_eligible with plan, country):
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied

to is_eligible with plan as text, country as text giving yesno:
    if plan is "enterprise":
        give back yes
    if plan is "pro":
        give back country is not "blocked"
    give back no
source_texts.delivery_quote_repo:
include "pricing.par"

to main:
    let distance_input be ask for a number ""
    let base_input be ask for a number ""
    let per_km_input be ask for a number ""
    let service be ask ""
    let distance be value of distance_input
    let base be value of base_input
    let per_km be value of per_km_input
    let amount be (delivery_quote with distance, base, per_km, service)
    say "quote=" + amount + "|service=" + service

to delivery_quote with distance as number, base as number, per_km as number, service as text giving number:
    let quote be base + (distance * per_km)
    if service is "express":
        set quote to quote + 300
    if distance is more than 100:
        set quote to quote + 500
    give back quote
source_texts.filtered_report_repo:
include "report_rules.par"

to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let min_length_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let min_length be value of min_length_input
    let saved be 0
    let skipped be 0
    let characters be 0
    let index be 0
    write title + "\n" to file "filtered_report.txt"
    repeat count times:
        set index to index + 1
        let entry be ask ""
        if (include_entry with entry, min_length):
            set saved to saved + 1
            set characters to characters + (length of entry)
            append (format_entry with index, entry) + "\n" to file "filtered_report.txt"
        otherwise:
            set skipped to skipped + 1
    say "saved=" + saved + "|skipped=" + skipped + "|characters=" + characters

to include_entry with entry as text, min_length as number giving yesno:
    give back length of entry is at least min_length

to format_entry with index as number, entry as text giving text:
    give back index + "|" + entry
source_texts.ledger_reconciliation_repo:
to absolute_difference with expected as number, actual as number giving number:
    if expected is at least actual:
        give back expected - actual
    give back actual - expected

to is_within_tolerance with difference as number, tolerance as number giving yesno:
    give back difference is at most tolerance

include "ledger.par"

to main:
    let tolerance_input be ask for a number ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let tolerance be value of tolerance_input
    let count be value of count_input
    let matched be 0
    let unmatched be 0
    let variance be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let id be item 1 of parts
        let expected be item 2 of parts as number
        let actual be item 3 of parts as number
        let difference be (absolute_difference with expected, actual)
        set variance to variance + difference
        if (is_within_tolerance with difference, tolerance):
            say id + ":match"
            set matched to matched + 1
        otherwise:
            say id + ":diff=" + difference
            set unmatched to unmatched + 1
    say "matched=" + matched + ",unmatched=" + unmatched + ",variance=" + variance

to include_message with priority as number, min_priority as number giving yesno:
    give back priority is at least min_priority

to format_message with index as number, priority as number, message as text giving text:
    give back index + "|" + priority + "|" + message

include "digest_rules.par"

to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let min_priority_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let min_priority be value of min_priority_input
    let saved be 0
    let skipped be 0
    let characters be 0
    let index be 0
    write title + "\n" to file "priority_digest.txt"
    repeat count times:
        set index to index + 1
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let priority be item 1 of parts as number
        remove item 1 of parts
        let message be parts joined with "|"
        if (include_message with priority, min_priority):
            set saved to saved + 1
            set characters to characters + (length of message)
            append (format_message with index, priority, message) + "\n" to file "priority_digest.txt"
        otherwise:
            set skipped to skipped + 1
    say "saved=" + saved + "|skipped=" + skipped + "|characters=" + characters
source_texts.incident_routing_repo:
include "routing.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email be 0
    let chat be 0
    let pager be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let severity be item 2 of parts
        let after_hours be item 3 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with severity, after_hours)
        say team + ":" + channel
        if channel is "email":
            set email to email + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat to chat + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager to pager + 1
    say "email=" + email + ",chat=" + chat + ",pager=" + pager

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:
    if severity is "low":
        give back "email"
    if severity is "high":
        if after_hours is "yes":
            give back "pager"
        give back "chat"
    give back "pager"

    let available be stock - reserved
    if available is less than 0:
        give back 0
    give back available

include "inventory.par"

to main:
    let stock_input be ask for a number ""
    let demand_input be ask for a number ""
    let reserved_input be ask for a number ""
    let mode be ask ""
    let stock be value of stock_input
    let demand be value of demand_input
    let reserved be value of reserved_input
    let available be (available_stock with stock, reserved, mode)
    let fulfilled be demand
    if fulfilled is more than available:
        set fulfilled to available
    let backorder be demand - fulfilled
    let remaining be available - fulfilled
    say "fulfilled=" + fulfilled + "|backorder=" + backorder + "|remaining=" + remaining

def delivery_quote(distance: int, base: int, per_km: int, service: str) -> int:
    quote = base + distance * per_km
    if service == "express":
        quote += 300
    if distance > 100:
        quote += 500
    return quote

from ledger import absolute_difference, is_within_tolerance

tolerance = int(input())
count = int(input())
matched = 0
variance = 0
for _ in range(count):
    entry_id, expected_text, actual_text = input().split("|")
    difference = absolute_difference(int(expected_text), int(actual_text))
    variance += difference
    if is_within_tolerance(difference, tolerance):
        matched += 1
        print(f"{entry_id}:match")
    else:
        print(f"{entry_id}:diff={difference}")
print(f"matched={matched},unmatched={count - matched},variance={variance}")

from pathlib import Path
from digest_rules import format_message, should_include

title = input()

    if should_include(priority, min_priority):
        messages.append((index, priority, text))
contents = title + "\n" + "".join(

)

characters = sum(len(text) for _, _, text in messages)
print(f"saved={saved}|skipped={count - saved}|characters={characters}")

source_texts.delivery_quote_repo:
include "pricing.par"

to main:
    let distance_input be ask for a number ""
    let base_input be ask for a number ""
    let per_km_input be ask for a number ""
    let service be ask ""
    let distance be value of distance_input
    let base be value of base_input
    let per_km be value of per_km_input
    let amount be (delivery_quote with distance, base, per_km, service)
    say "quote=" + amount + "|service=" + service

to delivery_quote with distance as number, base as number, per_km as number, service as text giving number:
    let quote be base + (distance * per_km)
    if service is "express":
        set quote to quote + 300
    if distance is more than 100:
        set quote to quote + 500
    give back quote
source_texts.incident_routing_repo:
include "routing.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email_count be 0
    let chat_count be 0
    let pager_count be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let severity be item 2 of parts
        let after_hours be item 3 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with severity, after_hours)
        if channel is "email":
            set email_count to email_count + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat_count to chat_count + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager_count to pager_count + 1
        say team + ":" + channel
    say "email=" + email_count + ",chat=" + chat_count + ",pager=" + pager_count

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:
    if severity is "low":
        give back "email"
    if severity is "critical":
        give back "pager"
    if after_hours is "yes":
        give back "pager"
    give back "chat"
source_texts.inventory_reservation_repo:
to available_stock with stock as number, reserved as number, mode as text giving number:
    if mode is "urgent":
        give back stock
    if reserved is more than stock:
        give back 0
    give back stock - reserved

include "inventory.par"

to main:
    let stock_input be ask for a number ""
    let demand_input be ask for a number ""
    let reserved_input be ask for a number ""
    let mode be ask ""
    let stock be value of stock_input
    let demand be value of demand_input
    let reserved be value of reserved_input
    let available be (available_stock with stock, reserved, mode)
    let fulfilled be demand
    if fulfilled is more than available:
        set fulfilled to available
    let backorder be demand - fulfilled
    let remaining be available - fulfilled
    say "fulfilled=" + fulfilled + "|backorder=" + backorder + "|remaining=" + remaining
source_texts.priority_digest_repo:
to include_priority with priority as number, minimum as number giving yesno:
    give back priority is at least minimum

to format_message with index as number, priority as number, message as text giving text:
    give back index + "|" + priority + "|" + message

include "digest_rules.par"

to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let minimum_input be ask for a number ""
    let minimum be value of minimum_input
    let messages be an empty list of text
    let priorities be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let priority be item 1 of parts as number
        remove item 1 of parts
        let message be parts joined with "|"
        add priority to priorities
        add message to messages
    write title + "\n" to file "priority_digest.txt"
    let saved be 0
    let characters be 0
    for each index from 1 to count:
        let priority be item index of priorities
        let message be item index of messages
        if (include_priority with priority, minimum):
            append (format_message with index, priority, message) + "\n" to file "priority_digest.txt"
            set saved to saved + 1
            set characters to characters + (length of message)
    let skipped be count - saved
    say "saved=" + saved + "|skipped=" + skipped + "|characters=" + characters

source_texts.ledger_reconciliation_repo:
to absolute_difference with expected as number, actual as number giving number:
    if expected is at least actual:
        give back expected - actual
    give back actual - expected

to is_within_tolerance with difference as number, tolerance as number giving yesno:
    give back difference is at most tolerance

include "ledger.par"

to main:
    let tolerance_input be ask for a number ""
    let tolerance be value of tolerance_input
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let matched be 0
    let unmatched be 0
    let variance be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let id be item 1 of parts
        let expected be item 2 of parts as number
        let actual be item 3 of parts as number
        let difference be (absolute_difference with expected, actual)
        set variance to variance + difference
        if (is_within_tolerance with difference, tolerance):
            say id + ":match"
            set matched to matched + 1
        otherwise:
            say id + ":diff=" + difference
            set unmatched to unmatched + 1
    say "matched=" + matched + ",unmatched=" + unmatched + ",variance=" + variance

    give back no

from pricing import delivery_quote

distance = int(input())
base = int(input())
per_km = int(input())
service = input()
amount = delivery_quote(distance, base, per_km, service)
print(f"quote={amount}|service={service}")

def delivery_quote(distance: int, base: int, per_km: int, service: str) -> int:
    quote = base + distance * per_km
    if service == "express":
        quote += 300
    if distance > 100:
        quote += 500
    return quote

def available_stock(stock: int, reserved: int, mode: str) -> int:
    if mode == "urgent":
        return stock
    return max(stock - reserved, 0)

from inventory import available_stock

stock = int(input())
demand = int(input())
reserved = int(input())
mode = input()

fulfilled = min(demand, available)
backorder = demand - fulfilled
remaining = available - fulfilled
print(f"fulfilled={fulfilled}|backorder={backorder}|remaining={remaining}")
source_texts.support_sla_repo:
from sla import due_minutes

priority = input()
tier = input()
after_hours = input()
print(f"due_minutes={due_minutes(priority, tier, after_hours)}|tier={tier}")

def due_minutes(priority: str, tier: str, after_hours: str) -> int:
    base_minutes = {"normal": 480, "high": 120, "critical": 30}[priority]
    if tier == "premium":
        base_minutes = max(base_minutes - 30, 15)
    if after_hours == "yes":
        base_minutes += 60
    return base_minutes
source_texts.priority_digest_repo:
def should_include(priority: int, min_priority: int) -> bool:
    return priority >= min_priority


def format_message(index: int, priority: int, message: str) -> str:
    return f"{index}|{priority}|{message}"

from pathlib import Path
from digest_rules import format_message, should_include

title = input()
count = int(input())
min_priority = int(input())
messages = []
for index in range(1, count + 1):
    priority_text, message = input().split("|", 1)
    priority = int(priority_text)
    if should_include(priority, min_priority):
        messages.append((index, priority, message))
contents = title + "\n" + "".join(
    format_message(index, priority, message) + "\n"
    for index, priority, message in messages
)
Path("priority_digest.txt").write_text(contents, encoding="utf-8")
saved = len(messages)
print(
    f"saved={saved}|skipped={count - saved}|"
    f"characters={sum(len(message) for _, _, message in messages)}"
)

def due_minutes(priority: str, tier: str, after_hours: str) -> int:
    base_minutes = {"normal": 480, "high": 120, "critical": 30}[priority]
    if tier == "premium":
        base_minutes = max(base_minutes - 30, 15)
    if after_hours == "yes":
        base_minutes += 60
    return base_minutes

source_texts.incident_routing_repo:
include "routing.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email_count be 0
    let chat_count be 0
    let pager_count be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let severity be item 2 of parts
        let after_hours be item 3 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with severity, after_hours)
        if channel is "email":
            set email_count to email_count + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat_count to chat_count + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager_count to pager_count + 1
        say team + ":" + channel
    say "email=" + email_count + ",chat=" + chat_count + ",pager=" + pager_count

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:
    if severity is "low":
        give back "email"
    if severity is "high":
        if after_hours is "yes":
            give back "pager"
        give back "chat"
    give back "pager"

        add entry to entries

to absolute_difference with expected as number, actual as number giving number:

        give back expected - actual
    give back actual - expected

to is_within_tolerance with difference as number, tolerance as number giving yesno:
    give back difference is at most tolerance

include "ledger.par"

to main:
    let tolerance_input be ask for a number ""
    let tolerance be value of tolerance_input
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let matched be 0
    let unmatched be 0
    let variance be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let identifier be item 1 of parts
        let expected be item 2 of parts as number
        let actual be item 3 of parts as number
        let difference be (absolute_difference with expected, actual)
        set variance to variance + difference
        if (is_within_tolerance with difference, tolerance):
            say identifier + ":match"
            set matched to matched + 1
        otherwise:
            say identifier + ":diff=" + difference
            set unmatched to unmatched + 1
    say "matched=" + matched + ",unmatched=" + unmatched + ",variance=" + variance

def delivery_quote(distance: int, base: int, per_km: int, service: str) -> int:

    if service == "express":
        quote += 300
    if distance > 100:
        quote += 500
    return quote

def delivery_quote(distance: int, base: int, per_km: int, service: str) -> int:
    quote = base + distance * per_km
    if service == "express":
        quote += 300
    if distance > 100:
        quote += 500
    return quote

from ledger import absolute_difference, is_within_tolerance

tolerance = int(input())
count = int(input())
matched = 0
variance = 0
for _ in range(count):
    entry_id, expected_text, actual_text = input().split("|", 2)
    difference = absolute_difference(int(expected_text), int(actual_text))
    variance += difference
    if is_within_tolerance(difference, tolerance):
        matched += 1
        print(f"{entry_id}:match")
    else:
        print(f"{entry_id}:diff={difference}")

print(f"matched={matched},unmatched={count - matched},variance={variance}")

source_texts.filtered_report_repo:
include "report_rules.par"

to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let min_length_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let min_length be value of min_length_input
    let characters be 0
    let saved be 0
    let skipped be 0
    write title + "\n" to file "filtered_report.txt"
    for each index from 1 to count:
        let entry be ask ""
        if (include_entry with entry, min_length):
            append (format_entry with index, entry) + "\n" to file "filtered_report.txt"
            set saved to saved + 1
            set characters to characters + (length of entry)
        otherwise:
            set skipped to skipped + 1
    say "saved=" + saved + "|skipped=" + skipped + "|characters=" + characters

to include_entry with entry as text, min_length as number giving yesno:
    give back (length of entry) is at least min_length

to format_entry with index as number, entry as text giving text:
    give back index + "|" + entry
source_texts.delivery_quote_repo:
include "pricing.par"

to main:
    let distance_input be ask for a number ""
    let base_input be ask for a number ""
    let per_km_input be ask for a number ""
    let service be ask ""
    let distance be value of distance_input
    let base be value of base_input
    let per_km be value of per_km_input
    let amount be (delivery_quote with distance, base, per_km, service)
    say "quote=" + amount + "|service=" + service

to delivery_quote with distance as number, base as number, per_km as number, service as text giving number:
    let amount be base + (distance * per_km)
    if service is "express":
        set amount to amount + 300
    if distance is more than 100:
        set amount to amount + 500
    give back amount

to include_message with priority as number, min_priority as number giving yesno:
    give back priority is at least min_priority

to format_message with index as number, priority as number, message as text giving text:
    give back index + "|" + priority + "|" + message

include "digest_rules.par"

to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let min_priority_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let min_priority be value of min_priority_input
    let characters be 0
    let saved be 0
    let skipped be 0
    write title + "\n" to file "priority_digest.txt"
    for each index from 1 to count:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let priority be item 1 of parts as number
        remove item 1 of parts
        let message be parts joined with "|"
        if (include_message with priority, min_priority):
            append (format_message with index, priority, message) + "\n" to file "priority_digest.txt"
            set saved to saved + 1
            set characters to characters + (length of message)
        otherwise:
            set skipped to skipped + 1
    say "saved=" + saved + "|skipped=" + skipped + "|characters=" + characters
source_texts.incident_routing_repo:
include "routing.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email_count be 0
    let chat_count be 0
    let pager_count be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let severity be item 2 of parts
        let after_hours be item 3 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with severity, after_hours)
        say team + ":" + channel
        if channel is "email":
            set email_count to email_count + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat_count to chat_count + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager_count to pager_count + 1
    say "email=" + email_count + ",chat=" + chat_count + ",pager=" + pager_count

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:
    if severity is "low":
        give back "email"
    if severity is "critical":
        give back "pager"
    if after_hours is "yes":
        give back "pager"
    give back "chat"
source_texts.inventory_reservation_repo:
to available_stock with stock as number, reserved as number, mode as text giving number:
    if mode is "urgent":
        give back stock
    if reserved is more than stock:
        give back 0
    give back stock - reserved

include "inventory.par"

to main:
    let stock_input be ask for a number ""
    let demand_input be ask for a number ""
    let reserved_input be ask for a number ""
    let mode be ask ""
    let stock be value of stock_input
    let demand be value of demand_input
    let reserved be value of reserved_input
    let available be (available_stock with stock, reserved, mode)
    let fulfilled be demand
    if fulfilled is more than available:
        set fulfilled to available
    let backorder be demand - fulfilled
    let remaining be available - fulfilled
    say "fulfilled=" + fulfilled + "|backorder=" + backorder + "|remaining=" + remaining

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input

    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let plan be item 2 of parts
        let country be item 3 of parts
        if (is_eligible with plan, country):
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied

to is_eligible with plan as text, country as text giving yesno:
    if plan is "enterprise":

    if plan is "pro":
        give back country is not "blocked"
    give back no

to absolute_difference with expected as number, actual as number giving number:
    if expected is at least actual:
        give back expected - actual
    give back actual - expected

to is_within_tolerance with difference as number, tolerance as number giving yesno:
    give back difference is at most tolerance

include "ledger.par"

to main:
    let tolerance_input be ask for a number ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let tolerance be value of tolerance_input
    let count be value of count_input
    let matched be 0
    let unmatched be 0
    let variance be 0
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let id be item 1 of parts
        let expected be item 2 of parts as number
        let actual be item 3 of parts as number
        let difference be (absolute_difference with expected, actual)
        set variance to variance + difference
        if (is_within_tolerance with difference, tolerance):
            say id + ":match"
            set matched to matched + 1
        otherwise:
            say id + ":diff=" + difference
            set unmatched to unmatched + 1
    say "matched=" + matched + ",unmatched=" + unmatched + ",variance=" + variance

from pathlib import Path
from report_rules import format_entry, should_include

title = input()
count = int(input())
min_length = int(input())
entries = [input() for _ in range(count)]
included = [
    (index, entry)
    for index, entry in enumerate(entries, 1)
    if should_include(entry, min_length)
]
contents = title + "\n" + "".join(
    format_entry(index, entry) + "\n"
    for index, entry in included
)
Path("filtered_report.txt").write_text(contents, encoding="utf-8")
saved = len(included)
print(
    f"saved={saved}|skipped={count - saved}"
    f"|characters={sum(len(entry) for _, entry in included)}"
)

def should_include(entry: str, min_length: int) -> bool:
    return len(entry) >= min_length


def format_entry(index: int, entry: str) -> str:
    return f"{index}|{entry}"
